remarks: Welcome to this charming 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath home nestled in a quiet, well-established neighborhood and sitting on a level corner lot.  As you enter this classic Cape, the welcoming layout of the main level immediately makes you feel at home. This well-loved family home has been occupied by the same family for over 70 years. It is now ready for a new family to personalize and make your own. The cozy living room features a wood-burning fireplace and flows seamlessly into the dining room. This versatile home features hardwood floors throughout. The kitchen is ready for a refresh, offering the opportunity to design it to your taste. The flexible room on the main level can be used as an office, a third bedroom, or playroom. The upper level features 2 spacious bedrooms and a full bath. The basement offers an expansive woodworking space, ample storage, and laundry area. It can also be finished, adding additional living space to fit your needs. There is also potential to expand above the attached two-car garage. This home offers the opportunity to get into the Darien community, with its top notch schools, restaurants, and beaches. Enjoy the proximity to the Darien Arts Center, parks, and major highways. Whether you're a first-time buyer or a seasoned investor, this home offers a rare opportunity to live in a sought-after area.    HIGHEST AND BEST BY 5PM ON 04/30/25
